# CANDIDATE: VWAP_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09

## Hypothesis

When price fails to hold VWAP on rising volume, it indicates distribution and a short‑term top. This edge exists because institutional selling pressure often manifests as price breaking below VWAP on elevated volume, signaling a shift from accumulation to distribution and a higher probability of near-term downside.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If price crosses VWAP from above to below on a candle that closes below VWAP AND the volume on that candle is > 1.5x the 20‑period average volume AND the 9 EMA is below the 20 EMA (ribbon bearish), then enter short at the close. Exit shape: Stop at the highest high of the prior 3 candles (chart‑stop), target at 1.5R, with a runner trailing using a 20% chandelier exit after 1R profit.
